description: Save the current workspace as a Studio scene under UserData/Studio/scene, thumbnail included, so it can be reopened later with studio_load_scene. This is the only way to make anything built with the other write tools persist. Non-destructive to the live scene: nothing is unloaded and the undo stack is left intact. Refuses to replace an existing scene unless overwrite is true.

name.description: file name, or a forward-slash relative path, under the scene folder (e.g. 'agent/run17'). The .png extension is added when missing. Must stay inside the scene folder. Omitted: Studio's own timestamped name, which never collides.

overwrite.description: replace the file if it already exists (default false)

relative_path.description: path relative to the scene folder — the value to hand back to studio_load_scene

objects.description: number of objects serialised into the scene

overwritten.description: true if an existing file was replaced

thumbnail.description: size of the preview image embedded at the head of the file (fixed by Studio)

scene.description: same shape as studio_get_scene, as saved
